title: Cover numbers by graph families bounded by certain graph parameters
summary: The cover number of a graph by a graph class $\mathcal P$ is the least number of $\mathcal P$-graphs necessary to cover its edges. A classical theorem of Harary, Hsu and Miller gives an exact formula for the cover number by the class of graphs with chromatic number at most $k$. We investigate analogous questions for the case of the fractional chromatic number $χ_f$ and the local chromatic number $ψ$.
